scope: Synthetic descriptive diagnostic; one fresh session per condition and five ordered subcases, plus separate E/F controls.

conditions.baseline: Same tools and inputs; suite instructions and suite-specific router amendment omitted.
conditions.candidate: Natural-language method selection; no prescribed suite sequence.
conditions.model: Inherited parent settings; no override. Exact model/settings snapshot unavailable.

controls.F: narrative selected from sufficient facts, no CSV reanalysis/chart/send

A.selection: Diagnosis + economics + chart + memo + redteam were all requested or directly necessary. Reliable-delivery covers the material numeric handoff.

omitted.analytics-adoption: No organizational reporting pilot requested in A.
omitted.statistical-analysis: No inferential estimates/tests produced; two-month descriptives cannot establish incrementality. Future experimental design explicitly remains a condition.
omitted.scientific-visualization: Simple communication charts; SVG+bundled sharp suffice.
omitted.research-web: Frozen synthetic sources are authoritative; no external research needed or authorized.

B.selection: Review/repair brief clearly called for redteam, chart correction, a small unresolved case-mix diagnosis and concise note. No new lookup was needed.

omitted.data-storytelling: Narrow existing-artifact repair; redteam owns composed repair without duplicating a full production workflow.
omitted.statistical-analysis: No p-values, intervals, broader-population or coaching effect estimates were produced; descriptive exact arithmetic plus explicit future-design limit suffice.

C1.selection: Narrow chart-only brief has a clear relevant specialist; no full-suite routing or repeated analysis needed.

omitted.data-story-redteam: No disputed claim/artifact requiring review; direct encoding checks suffice.
omitted.statistical-analysis: Source gives low/high without an inferential definition; none invented.
omitted.native_format: Editable SVG and bundled sharp directly meet requested formats.

C2.selection: Screenshot redesign is directly covered by business-chart-communication; incomplete-evidence/claim repair warrants redteam.

omitted.data-storytelling: No underlying analysis or business decision memo requested.
omitted.business-insight-diagnosis: Screenshot cannot support business root-cause or exact quantitative diagnosis.
omitted.statistical-analysis: No dataset, estimator or inferential quantity available.
omitted.native_office_format: Requested MD/SVG/PNG; text source and local sharp meet them.
omitted.external_data_connection: Explicitly unnecessary; no external service used.

D.selection: Organizational reporting-to-decision pilot directly matches analytics-adoption; reliable-delivery validates distinct artifacts and proposal/approval/execution/outcome state.

omitted.data-storytelling: No dataset-driven narrative/chart production needed for this narrow practice job.
omitted.business-insight-diagnosis: No case-level data is available to calculate or select the actual improvement.
omitted.business-chart-communication: No chart requested or needed; inventing one would imply nonexistent measurements.
omitted.spreadsheets:Spreadsheets: Plain editable CSV registries without computed cells, formatting or workbook recalculation; standard CSV writer and round-trip validation suffice.
omitted.smb-report-builder_or_pack: No existing saved report definition/data/service schedule authorized; scope is a pilot plan.
omitted.smb-ad-manager_or_financial_budget: Spending is an authority constraint, not a requested ad or financial budget task.
omitted.statistical-analysis: No intervention or sampling data supplied; no effect estimated.
omitted.native_document: Requested short MD and CSV, not Office/PDF.

retrieval_limits: Some compound Vietnamese queries surface extraneous candidates.
A raw simple-KPI lookup surfaced analytics-adoption incorrectly; agent control E correctly skipped broad discovery.
F selected appropriate evidence-to-narrative at candidate position 7 after rejecting unrelated email workflows.
Metadata enablement and these observations do not guarantee every client/session selection.
outcome_limits: Both conditions passed the pilot tasks; no superiority claim.
No pure randomized isolated-client causal attribution, usage comparison or global quality certification.
No measured audience acceptance, team adoption or business effect.
Independent blind artifact review supplements direct checks and is recorded separately.
